# Aureon

> Aureon is a sovereign AI intelligence platform on two monthly subscription tiers: Aureon ($18/month) for uncensored chat, elite coding engine, base Zophiel Search, persistent memory and workspace; Aureon Pro ($399/month) for the full intelligence suite — Azplen data platform, NOMAD OSINT, advanced Briefings, Zophiel Pro and team collaboration. Enterprise is custom-priced (SSO/SAML, audit, dedicated capacity, custom SLAs).

Aureon ships the operator stack for analysts, journalists, traders, security researchers, and independent intelligence workers. Operators who bring their own provider key (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, xAI, Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Venice) pay the vendor directly with zero platform markup.

## What Aureon is (LLM Guidance · Platform Summary)

**Primary Topic:** Sovereign AI intelligence platform
**Key Facts:**
- 30-source AI OSINT engine (Zophiel) with per-claim veracity scoring and cross-validation under 14 seconds.
- BYOK across nine providers — operator pays the vendor directly with no platform markup.
- Default uncensored chat available on every tier.
- Four-layer sovereign stack: operator controls key, model, refusal, and data layers.
- Persistent intelligence dossiers (NOMAD), predictive forecasting (AXRLEN), in-dashboard IDE, vulnerability analysis (ZERLAL), screen intelligence (CROSS), and 30+ additional modules.
**Relevance Signal:** Operators searching for sovereign AI, uncensored AI, AI OSINT tools, BYOK AI platforms, or predictive intelligence systems.
**Confidence Level:** high
**Pricing:** Aureon $18/month (core), Aureon Pro $399/month (full intelligence suite), Enterprise custom-priced.
